name: Pink-throated Brilliant
rangeDescription: Lower east slope of the andes from southern colombia to northern peru
description: Scarce hummingbird found in cloud forest in the eastern foothills of the Andes in Ecuador, southern Colombia, and northern Peru. Green with a white vent and a small white dot behind eye.

name: Sombre Hummingbird
rangeDescription: Forest and scrub of eastern and central brazil
description: A quite drab hummingbird with a slightly curved bill. Frequently encountered at the forest edge, in light woodlands, grasslands, and plantations.

name: American Avocet
rangeDescription: Southern canada to northern mexico; winters southern usa to costa rica and cuba
description: Distinctive large shorebird with a long, thin, upturned bill. Look for bold black-and-white wings and long blue-gray legs.

name: Andaman Boobook
rangeDescription: Andaman islands
description: A compact owl with brownish face and upperparts. Note the bold, rust-colored streaks running down the underparts.

name: Sumatran Drongo
rangeDescription: Humid lowlands of sumatra
description: Glossy large-billed drongo with glossy blue-sheened wings and tail. Also note bright red eyes, iridescent speckling around the throat and neck, and flared broad-tipped tail.

name: Painted Tody-Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Southern venezuela to the guianas and northern brazil (east of rio negro)
description: Tiny bird of forest canopy; difficult to see well and heard far more than seen. Appears mostly yellow from below.

name: Pinto's Spinetail
rangeDescription: Northeastern brazil (northeastern maranhão, eastern pernambuco, and adjacent alagoas)
description: Spinetail with a largely dark body contrasting with a rich rusty crown, wings, and tail. Note the streaked whitish throat.

name: White-chested Puffbird
rangeDescription: Southeastern colombia to eastern peru, the guianas, and western amazonian brazil
description: Brown-and-white streaked bird with a large head and yellowish bill; white crescent on chest is helpful for identification but can be difficult to see. Inhabits lower and middle levels of tall rainforest, where it is easily overlooked as it sits motionless for long periods before darting to tree trunks, foliage, or ground for large insect and small vertebrate prey.

name: White-browed Antpitta
rangeDescription: Interior northeastern brazil (piauí and ceará to far northern minas gerais)
description: Plump bird with a short tail and long legs. Unmistakable within its range.

name: Yellow-footed Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Southern nigeria and cameroon to gabon, democratic republic of the congo, and western uganda; bioko
description: An aptly named flycatcher of the lower parts of the forest edge and forest clearings. Overall grayish with a white belly, a white throat, a uniform gray chest, a mostly yellow bill, and unique bright yellow legs.

name: Yellow-eared Barbet
rangeDescription: Java and bali
description: Small leaf-green barbet, endemic to Java and Bali. Note bright sky-blue patches on face, shoulders, and undertail, as well as a bright yellow patch below each eye.

name: Jet Manakin
rangeDescription: East slope of andes from eastern ecuador (napo) to southern peru (puno)
description: Rarely encountered large manakin found in dense undergrowth of humid forests, mostly on outlying ridges along the east slope of the Andes. Male is entirely black with white underwings, visible when the wings are flicked or the bird flies; unlike any other manakin in range.

name: Tibetan Bunting
rangeDescription: Western china (borders of arid tibet, southwestern qinghai, and sichuan)
description: Handsome thickset bunting restricted to a small part of the eastern Qinghai-Tibetan plateau where it inhabits scrubby slopes above the timberline. Unmistakable in its range; no other bunting in the area combines its size, brick-orange back, and gray belly.

name: Taiwan Liocichla
rangeDescription: Montane forest of taiwan
description: The gloom of the forest may make this small songbird of dense montane forests and edges appear dark, but a bit of sunlight reveals a gloriously colorful plumage, with subtle patches of olive, blue, yellow, orange, and chestnut. Social, moving about in pairs or flocks, often emerging out into the open when gaps in the vegetation are present.

name: Baudin's Black-Cockatoo
rangeDescription: Far southwestern australia (south of the murchison river)
description: Black cockatoo with white ear patch and white tail panel. Inhabits moist eucalypt forest in the southwestern corner of Western Australia, where it eats seeds from large seed pods of Marri and Karri trees.

name: White-winged Flufftail
rangeDescription: Highlands of ethiopia and eastern south africa
description: Very rare, small rail of montane marshes. Extremely shy and elusive bird that is unlikely to be seen unless expressly looking for it.

name: Nuttall's Woodpecker
rangeDescription: Chaparral and oak woodland of northern california to northwestern baja
description: Small woodpecker almost entirely restricted to the state of California (barely entering northern Baja). Look for black-and-white barring on the back and patterned flanks.

name: Andaman Serpent-Eagle
rangeDescription: Forest of andaman islands
description: A relatively small, uniformly dark brown eagle with a contrasting bright-yellow bare patch between the eye and the bill. The underparts are speckled with small white spots.

name: Semicollared Puffbird
rangeDescription: Humid lowlands of southeastern peru, far western brazil, and northwestern bolivia
description: Chunky, large-headed bird of rainforest understory. Brown with extensive white streaking, and a band of reddish brown across the back of the neck.

name: Guadalcanal Owl
rangeDescription: Guadalcanal (southeastern solomon islands)
description: A rather small owl with lightly spotted brown upperparts and creamy underparts thickly barred with reddish brown. Inhabits forests from lowlands up into the highlands.
